lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with a higher density of smaller spots immediately adjacent to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the centroid spots to form a matrix of high-contrast anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high-luminance edges superiorly and low-luminance shadows inferiorly.

other_distinctive_markers: Several high-contrast, fusiform biological silhouettes are visible in the ventral region beneath the primary pectoral fin.
